The '''Gauntlet Dartcaster''' or the '''wrist dart launcher''' or simply '''dart launcher''' is a concealed weapon, usually hidden in the wrist plates or [[Gauntlet/Legends|gauntlet]] of [[battle armor]]. [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|Bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] had a [[Velocity-7 dart shooter|Velocity-7]]<ref name="NEGWT">''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> dartcaster in his [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]], just one of the many deadly tools in his arsenal, which ranged from [[WESTAR-34 blaster pistol/Legends|WESTAR-34 blaster pistol]], to a [[ZX miniature flame projector/Legends|ZX miniature flame projector]], a [[Whipcord launcher/Legends|whipcord launcher]], and [[Cutting torch/Legends|cutting torch]]. These dartcasters usually carried some form of [[Poison dart/Legends|poison dart]], Jango himself used [[Mk I Saberdart/Legends|Kamino saberdarts]], a very rare artifact.
